Issues:
1. `S1895PaperInput` unqualified resolves to a *different* structure (there's another `S1895PaperInput` in some other namespace) — need `open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1895OIdentificationsActual`. And `S1280Bad_subsingleton`/`S1280ReductionClause` need `open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1280SourceDefinition31Actual`.

Also `#check` output confirmed `paperQV` etc. But mostly the probe worked structurally: my `example` with `(reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v = SourceHaarActualValueMonoid := rfl` — the errors were only about the D type resolution (which cascade). Let me fix opens and re-run. Note the S1968 file itself opened `S1280SourceDefinition31Actual`, `S1527...`, etc.

Let me redo the probe with all the opens that S1968 uses, and add more checks:
- `(reducedQPilotTimesMu D).Mon` — does projection `Mon` work on SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip?
- `Finsupp.single_ne_zero`
- `Finsupp.zero_apply`
- `paperQPilotDivisor_apply`
- whether `Finsupp.single` with `IUTIVPlace.finite` etc. works
- `Multiplicative.toAdd` on `sourceHaarActualDegree x`
- Does `R6Proper` from S1968 + `r6Proper_of_equivalence` work.
- `SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripEquivalence.refl`, `FPrimeStripEquiv.toF` fields (`isoMon`).

Also check that `paperQPilotDivisor D  (IUTIVPlace.finite ...) = ...` etc.

Let me also check `SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism` API: `id`, `nonempty_iff`, `representative_exists`.

Let me write probe 2.

{"code": "
const probe = `import tmp.sheaf.xif.paper.S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual

noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.checkUnivs false

open LeanFormal.IUT
open LeanFormal.IUT.Theorem311Source
open LeanFormal.IUT.Theorem311Source.OriginalInput
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1895OIdentificationsActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1960QPilotAnchorActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1927GlobalFrobenioidLogShellActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1487OQPilotScalarEqualityActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1527OOrderEqualityActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1280SourceDefinition31Actual
open LeanFormal.IUT.IUTIV.Estimates
open LeanFormal.IUT.ArithmeticQPilotLogVolume
open LeanFormal.IUT.InitialThetaSource.PlacePartitionReduction

namespace ProbeS1979

local instance s1979GaussianIrreducible :
    Fact (Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (-1) : Polynomial ℚ)) :=
  ⟨gaussianPolynomial_irreducible⟩

local instance s1979FivePrime : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨Nat.prime_five⟩

/-- probe: the Mon of the anchor at a place is the nonpositive real monoid -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) :
    (reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v = SourceHaarActualValueMonoid := rfl

/-- probe: Mon projection works on the times-mu strip -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) :
    (reducedQPilotTimesMu D).Mon v = SourceHaarActualValueMonoid := rfl

/-- probe: element of the times-mu strip's monoid -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) (x : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) :
    (reducedQPilotTimesMu D).Mon v := x

/-- probe: 5 is a prime place -/
def paperBadPrime : PaperV :=
  ⟨5, mem_primeStrip_iff.mpr ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, Nat.prime_five⟩⟩

/-- probe: badPlaces is subsingleton -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) : Subsingleton (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces :=
  S1280Bad_subsingleton D.l

/-- probe: pos of q -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    0 < paperQV D b := by
  have h1 : paperQV D b = (S1280ReductionClause D.l).qParameter b := rfl
  rw [h1, S1527_qParameter_eq]
  exact pow_pos (by norm_num) _

/-- probe: ofAdd membership -/
def probeGen (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    SourceHaarActualValueMonoid :=
  Multiplicative.ofAdd ⟨-|Real.log (paperQV D b)|, by
    have : 0 ≤ |Real.log (paperQV D b)| := abs_nonneg _
    linarith⟩

/-- probe: toAdd of the generator -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    ((Multiplicative.toAdd (probeGen D b) : sourceHaarActualNonpositiveAddSubmonoid) : ℝ)
      = -|Real.log (paperQV D b)| := rfl

/-- probe: degree of the generator -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    sourceHaarActualDegree (probeGen D b) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-|Real.log (paperQV D b)|) := rfl

/-- probe: the divisor vanishing -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) : paperQPilotDivisor D ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have h1 := paperQPilotDivisor_apply D
  rw [h] at h1
  have h0 : (0 : IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D))
      (IUTIVPlace.finite (F := PaperFmod D) (paperBadBasePlace D (paperQVBad0 D))) = 0 := rfl
  rw [h0] at h1
  have hne : (paperQVOrder D (paperQVBad0 D) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have := paperQVOrder_pos D (paperQVBad0 D)
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt this
  exact hne h1.symm

#check @SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripEquivalence.refl
#check @SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripEquivalence
#check @SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism
#check @SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism.id
#check @SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism.nonempty_iff
#check @SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism.representative_exists
#check @QPilotAnchorIdentification
#check @r6Proper_of_equivalence
#check @R6Proper
#check @IUTIVPlace.weight_finite
#check @Finsupp.single_eq_same
#check @Finsupp.zero_apply
#check @Finsupp.single_ne_zero
#check @Finsupp.single_ne_zero_iff

end ProbeS1979
`;
await tools.write({ file_path: "tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1979probe2.lean", content: probe });
const out = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Compile S1979 probe 2", command: "cd D:\\lean; lake env lean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1979probe2.lean 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 400", timeoutMs: 900000 });
console.log(out.kind === "foreground" ? (out.stdout.text || "") + (out.stderr.text||"") + "\nEXIT=" + out.exitCode : JSON.stringify(out));
", "description": "Probe definitions, monoid, and API"}
